var_Output.title: var_Output
var_Output.description: Pre-formatted plain-text list of the account executive's pending renewals, sorted by soonest expiry. Each renewal is a block of lines covering contract and account name, coverage tier, annual contract value and margin, end date with days remaining, notice-window status, and a risk score with its largest contributing driver. Where a risk score is unavailable the text says so explicitly. If the account executive has no pending renewals, the value is a single sentence stating that rather than a list.
